{"candidate_rtl":"module alu_64bit(
    input [63:0] a, b,
    input [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [63:0] sum
);
wire arithmetic_mode;
wire subtract_mode;
wire [63:0] arithmetic_result;
wire [63:0] logic_result;
wire [63:0] arithmetic_x;
wire [63:0] arithmetic_y;

assign arithmetic_mode = ~Oper[2] & ~Oper[1];
assign subtract_mode = Oper[0] | Oper[1];
assign arithmetic_x = Oper[1] ? b : a;
assign arithmetic_y = Oper[1] ? a : b;
assign arithmetic_result = arithmetic_x + (arithmetic_y ^ {64{subtract_mode}}) + subtract_mode;
assign logic_result = (Oper == 3'b011) ? (a | b) :
                      (Oper == 3'b100) ? (a & b) :
                      (Oper == 3'b101) ? (a ^ b) :
                      (Oper == 3'b110) ? (a ~^ b) : 64'b0;

always @(*) begin
    if (arithmetic_mode)
        sum = arithmetic_result;
    else if (Oper == 3'b111)
        sum = 64'b0;
    else
        sum = logic_result;
end
endmodule","bottleneck":"The dominant path is the 64-bit add/subtract datapath and its operation-selection multiplexing. The original separately expresses three arithmetic cases, allowing duplicated or poorly shared arithmetic structures before final selection.","rewrite":"Use one shared 64-bit arithmetic datapath. Select and optionally swap operands for the two subtraction directions, conditionally complement the second operand, and add the carry-in for subtraction. Keep the logical operations on a separate low-depth path and select arithmetic, logical, or zero according to the exact operation encoding.","expected_timing_gain":"Expected modest improvement in maximum data arrival, primarily from sharing one arithmetic carry chain and reducing arithmetic-result selection depth. The exact gain depends on ABC decomposition and SKY130 cell mapping; all arithmetic outputs remain modulo 2^64 as in the original RTL.","area_or_other_cost":"Likely reduced mapped area from replacing separate add/subtract structures with one shared adder, with a small amount of operand-selection and control logic added. The design remains well below the stated area cap in expectation and has no storage, latch, clock, or external dependency.","functional_boundaries":"For Oper=000, compute a+b; 001 computes a-b; 010 computes b-a; 011 computes a|b; 100 computes a&b; 101 computes a^b; 110 computes a~^b; and all other values, including 111, produce 64'b0. All operands are unsigned 64-bit vectors and arithmetic truncates to 64 bits. The original internal c_out is not an output and its assigned carry is unobservable; the candidate therefore preserves every observable output bit for all input combinations."}
